changes_made.explanation: Simplified the task to focus specifically on Knowledge Graph Question Answering as that's the main NLG task studied. Normalized output description to be more concise.

Removed graph quality metrics (Relevance, Semantic Richness, Redundancy) as they are used to evaluate the intermediate graph generation quality, not the final NLG outputs. Kept only the standard NLG evaluation metrics used for the final question answering outputs.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are used for generation and graph enrichment, but not for evaluating the quality of generated outputs.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations of the generated outputs. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) using LLMs. The main NLG task is generating answers to natural language questions based on knowledge graphs. The paper uses standard automatic metrics (Hits@1, F1, Precision) for evaluation. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. The extraction was generally accurate but included some intermediate metrics that shouldn't be considered NLG output evaluation metrics.
